title: Unused loop binder `i` deviates from the project's `for _ in` idiom for unused binders
detail: The loop body never references `i`; the codebase's established idiom for an unused range binder is `for _ in` (rng_test.odin x3). Non-functional: `odin test core` is 36/36 green and CI runs without `-vet`, so it never fires there.
recommended_fix: Change `for i in 0..<parallel_pipes` to `for _ in 0..<parallel_pipes` to match the established convention (and silence a local `-vet` pass).
